_comment: Tolerated high/critical npm advisories (QG-S2). Only unpatched dev/release tooling (semantic-release, markdownlint-cli2, never shipped in the app runtime). The expiry is 30 days (an assumption, starting value; chosen by the owner on 2026-10-29), so upstream fixes get picked up soon; when it passes, tools/check/delivery/supply/check-audit.mjs fails so each entry gets re-reviewed: look for a patched release first, then extend with a new reason or remove the entry.
